# Learning material index

<!-- Generated by build_index.py from manifest.json; edit the manifest, then rerun. -->

Branch: **`learning`** (locked). The learning material lives on the learning branch, which is never merged into master. Changes arrive by pull request from a work branch (learning-surfaces); master keeps only what it already had (chapters 1 and 2, the interactive Earth). GitHub branch protection on learning: changes only through pull requests, no force pushes, no deletion. See [the lock](README.md#the-lock).

Each component below lists its entry page, the scripts that generate it, its docs and its checks.
Commands run from the repository root; `$PY` is `$(./scripts/resolve_python_env.sh)`. The browser
tools need Playwright with Chromium (or a `--chrome` binary).

## Tutorials

<a id="chapter-1"></a>

### Chapter 1 · Gluing edges and recognizing topological surfaces

Edge identifications of one square, its symmetry group D4, quotient invariants and a classifier: 12 complete gluings, 6 classes, 4 closed surfaces.

- **Folder:** [`tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies)
- **Entry:** [chapter_01_gluing_and_topologies.md](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/chapter_01_gluing_and_topologies.md)
- **Generators:** [`square_gluings.py`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/square_gluings.py), [`01_enumerate.py`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/01_enumerate.py), [`02_d4_orbits.py`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/02_d4_orbits.py), [`03_classify.py`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/03_classify.py)
- **Docs:** [`README.md`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/README.md)
- **Checks:** [`test_square_gluings.py`](tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/test_square_gluings.py)
- **Origin:** master (PR #192)

```sh
"$PY" learning/tutorials/gluing-and-topologies/01_enumerate.py
"$PY" -m unittest discover -s learning/tutorials/gluing-and-topologies -p "test_square_gluings.py"
```

### Lesson 03 · Can you come home mirrored?

<a id="square-gluing-viewers"></a>

### Square gluing viewers (interactive)

## Keeping it consistent

- [`manifest.json`](manifest.json) is the source of this index; `python3 learning/build_index.py` rewrites it.
- The offline edition (`released/`) covers `tutorials/`, `boys-surface-viewer/`, `surface-sequences/`, `projective-plane-sequence/`, `sphere-sequence/`, `torus-sequence/`, `klein-bottle-sequence/` and links
  files it does not copy to GitHub at commit `a4eb4f57`.
- `python3 learning/check_manifest.py` checks the branch lock, every listed file, the links in every doc,
  that this index is current, and that the offline edition matches its sources.
- [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) records the security review of this material and how to repeat it.
